reason: The README clearly describes a dsh web plugin that visualizes keyword statistics from streamed reasoning blocks in a session-side floating panel, with local per-session persistence and no stated external data transfer.

summaries.zh: NoLetMe 是一个 dsh 网页端可视化插件，用于在会话页面实时展示推理块中的关键词统计和推理风格指标。
summaries.en: NoLetMe is a dsh web visualization plugin that displays real-time keyword statistics and reasoning-style metrics from conversation reasoning blocks.

capabilities: Reads reasoning blocks and conversation snapshots in the dsh web client
Computes keyword counts and trajectory-style statistics
Displays a floating overlay panel in the session interface
Persists per-session counters in browser localStorage
